EMPLOYMENT AGREEMENT (VERSION B - REVISED)

SECTION 1: TITLE AND PARTIES
This Agreement is entered into between Acme Corporation Inc. ("Company") and John Doe ("Employee").

SECTION 2: POSITION AND DUTIES
Employee shall serve as Principal Software Architect and shall perform all customary duties with reasonable care and diligence.

SECTION 3: COMPENSATION
Company shall pay Employee an annual base salary payable semi-monthly on the 15th and last day of each month. Annual performance bonus shall be discretionary and subject to board approval.

SECTION 8: RESTRICTIVE COVENANTS
8.1 Non-Competition: Employee agrees that for a period of twelve (12) months following termination of employment for any reason, Employee shall not engage in any competing software enterprise within the territory.
8.2 Non-Solicitation: Employee shall not solicit Company clients or employees for a period of twenty-four (24) months post-termination.

SECTION 11: TERMINATION
11.1 At-Will: Employment is at-will and may be terminated by either party.
11.2 Voluntary Resignation: In the event of voluntary resignation, Employee shall provide ninety (90) days prior written notice.

SECTION 14: DISPUTE RESOLUTION
Any controversy or claim arising out of this Agreement shall be settled by binding arbitration in New York in accordance with AAA rules.

SECTION 15: DATA PRIVACY AND AI USAGE
Employee shall not disclose any company code or algorithms to unapproved external generative AI tools without prior compliance approval.
